eyebrow: Cross-Platform Relational Database Administration · Chapter Fourteen
subtitle: Lesson 71 · PostgreSQL Backup & Recovery

code:
pg_basebackup -D /var/lib/postgresql/backup \
  -Ft -z -P -U replicator -h primary_host

Requires:
  role with REPLICATION attribute
  pg_hba.conf entry allowing replication conn
caption: pg_basebackup uses the same protocol a streaming replica uses to catch up.

code:
-D   target directory
-Ft -z   tar format, compressed
-P   show progress
-X stream   WAL streamed alongside (self-contained)
-R   write standby.signal (ready as a replica)
caption: A base backup is consistent as of the moment it finished — nothing more recent.

subtitle: Turning a base backup into recovery to any moment.
